Full Marks Description: Research problem, motivation, background, target users/use case, and proposed solution are exceptionally clear. The proposal precisely explains why the problem matters, what gap it addresses, and what contribution is expected. Implications and consequences are explicitly discussed.
Very Good Description: Research problem and motivation are clear and well-structured. The proposal explains the proposed solution and connects it to research significance, but implications or consequences may not be fully deep.
Good Description: Provides a generally understandable topic, background, motivation, and proposed solution. Some significance is mentioned, but the problem definition may be broad or slightly repetitive.
Satisfactory Description: Identifies the general topic and purpose, but the research problem, motivation, or proposed solution is vague. Implications are limited or only partially correct.
Poor Description: Problem definition is unclear, fragmented, or mostly descriptive. Motivation is weak and implications/consequences are missing or incorrect.

Full Marks Description: All proposal-generation stages are logically connected and mutually supportive. Literature analysis, gap identification, hypothesis generation, method design, and evaluation planning form a coherent reasoning chain with clear inputs/outputs between stages.
Very Good Description: The workflow is coherent and most stage transitions are explained. The connection between stages is clear, though some dependencies or justifications could be more explicit.
Good Description: Main stages are identifiable and generally connected. Some parts of the reasoning chain are under-explained or only loosely linked.
Satisfactory Description: Stages are listed, but their relationships are weak. The pipeline is understandable at a high level but lacks internal logic and detailed transition explanation.
Poor Description: The workflow is fragmented or inconsistent. Stages appear independent, repeated, or logically disconnected.

Full Marks Description: The proposal presents a meaningfully distinct research angle compared with retrieved/published work. It clearly identifies limitations in prior approaches and explains a specific methodological, conceptual, or evaluation-level contribution.
Very Good Description: The proposal shows clear novelty and differentiates itself from related work. Some contribution claims are well justified, though not all are deeply analyzed.
Good Description: The proposal has some original elements or useful combinations of existing ideas. Novelty is identifiable but moderate, and the difference from literature may need stronger justification.
Satisfactory Description: The proposal mostly adapts existing methods with limited originality. It mentions novelty but does not clearly show why the contribution is distinct.
Poor Description: The proposal is highly derivative, overlaps heavily with existing work, or provides unclear contribution.

Full Marks Description: The project is realistically achievable with available resources. It includes clear datasets or input sources, baselines/comparison groups, evaluation metrics, implementation plan, risk awareness, and measurable success criteria.
Very Good Description: The plan is feasible and includes appropriate baselines, resources, milestones, and evaluation criteria. Some implementation risks or measurement details may need further refinement.
Good Description: The project appears workable and includes general baselines or evaluation methods, but experimental details, resources, or success criteria are incomplete.
Satisfactory Description: The proposal mentions evaluation or implementation, but baselines, metrics, datasets, or feasibility constraints are vague.
Poor Description: The experimental plan is unrealistic, incomplete, or lacks measurable evaluation. Resource requirements and baselines are mostly absent.

Full Marks Description: The proposal is strongly grounded in retrieved papers. It accurately summarizes relevant literature, identifies research gaps, compares prior approaches, and explains how the proposal extends or differs from them.
Very Good Description: The proposal uses relevant literature and positions the work clearly. It identifies gaps and relationships to prior work, though critical comparison could be deeper.
Good Description: The proposal cites or uses relevant papers, but the connection between literature and proposed method is partly descriptive or superficial.
Satisfactory Description: Some related work is mentioned, but alignment is weak. The proposal does not clearly explain how retrieved papers support the research direction.
Poor Description: Literature use is minimal, inaccurate, or disconnected from the proposal.

Full Marks Description: The proposal demonstrates mature academic thinking: verifiable assumptions, theoretical awareness, methodological rigor, limitation awareness, and ability to move beyond surface-level summarization toward research-level insight.
Very Good Description: The proposal demonstrates strong research depth and critical thinking, but some assumptions, limitations, or theoretical connections are not fully developed.
Good Description: The proposal shows acceptable academic depth with identifiable reasoning and methodology, but it lacks consistent rigor or abstraction.
Satisfactory Description: The proposal has a basic research structure but limited critical analysis, weak assumptions, or shallow methodological reasoning.
Poor Description: The proposal lacks academic depth and mainly reads as a task plan or product description.

Full Marks Description: Writing is clear, concise, professional, and easy to follow. Sections are well organized, terminology is consistent, and citations/figures/tables are used appropriately.
Very Good Description: Writing and structure are clear with minor issues. Section flow is mostly smooth and academic tone is appropriate.
Good Description: The proposal is understandable but contains some unclear transitions, repetitive wording, or inconsistent academic style.
Satisfactory Description: Basic structure exists, but writing clarity, formatting, or section organization is limited.
Poor Description: Writing is difficult to follow, poorly organized, or lacks academic presentation conventions.
